# lodash.sortby v4.7.0

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.sortBy` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.sortby
```

In Node.js:
```js
var sortBy = require('lodash.sortby');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#sortBy) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.7.0-npm-packages/lodash.sortby) for more details.
